utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Could the Registrar call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is case IT-04-75-I, the Prosecutor versus Goran Hadzic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Good afternoon to everybody in and around the courtroom. I call upon the parties for their appearances, starting with the Prosecution, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Kenneth Scott appearing for the Prosecution, along with Maxine Marcus and our Case Manager Mr. Thomas Laugel.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you. For Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. My name is Zoran Zivanovic. I have been appointed as Duty Counsel to represent Mr. Goran Hadzic. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you very much. May I confirm with Mr. Hadzic that he can follow the proceedings in a language he understands.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Microphone not activated]

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Microphone, please.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, I'm in a position to confirm that.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Hadzic, would you please state your full name for the record, please.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] My name is Goran Hadzic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: You may be seated, Mr. Hadzic. What is the date and place of your birth, please.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Vinkovci, the 7th of September, 1958.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you. I am Judge Delvoie, both the Presiding Judge and the Pre-Trial Judge in this case. The other Judges of the Trial Chamber are Judge Hall and Judge Mindua. The purpose of today's Further Appearance is to call upon Mr. Hadzic to enter a plea to the operative indictment which was filed on the 22nd of July, 2011. A corrigendum to the indictment was filed on the 3rd of August, 2011. The hearing is to be conducted in accordance with Rule 62 of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence of this Tribunal. Before we move further, I would like to inform you, Mr. Hadzic, that you have a fundamental right to remain silent throughout these proceedings and that it will not be held against you if you do. Further, Articles 20 and 21 of the Statute of the Tribunal guarantee you a number of rights which, I recall, were read to you at Initial Appearance held on the 25th of July, 2011, before Judge O-Gon Kwon. At this Initial Appearance, Judge Kwon asked you if you wished to have the indictment read. You indicated, through your counsel, that you had familiarized yourself with the content of the indictment and that you did not wish to have it read aloud in court. I will ask you again today if you wish to have the indictment read aloud or whether you waive the reading of the indictment.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I waive the right, Your Honour. I do not wish to hear it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you. I will now ask you, Mr. Hadzic, to plead to the charges contained within the indictment. Could you please stand up for a moment.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Mr. Hadzic, how do you plead to the charges contained within the indictment?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Not guilty, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Please be seated, Mr. Hadzic.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: That concludes the entry of your plea, which was the purpose of this Further Appearance. In due course, a date will be set for the commencement of the trial, pursuant to Rule 62(A)(v). A Status Conference in according with Rule 65 bis soon will be scheduled in order to advance the preparation of this case for trial as well as to allow you, Mr. Hadzic, the opportunity to raise issues in relation thereto. One matter that I wish to raise before we adjourn is the disclosure to the Defence of the material supporting the indictment. Yesterday, the 23rd of August, 2011, the Trial Chamber issued its decision on the Prosecution motion for protective measures for victims and witnesses and documentary evidence. In this decision, the Chamber ordered, pursuant to Rule 66(A)(i), the Prosecution to disclose to the Defence by no later than the 23rd of September, 2011, the supporting material that accompanied the indictment when confirmation was sought and all prior statements obtained by the Prosecution from Mr. Hadzic. The Chamber also ordered the Prosecution by no later than 23 September to inform the Chamber and the Defence if any of the Rule 66(A)(i) material is covered by Rule 70 restrictions. The Trial Chamber will issue further orders in relation to additional disclosure in due course, such as required under Rule 66(A)(ii). Finally, I would like to mention, in order to avoid any misunderstandings, that pursuant to Rule 72(A), the 30-day time-limit for the filing of preliminary motions will not commence until permanent counsel is assigned to Mr. Hadzic. And this is notwithstanding the fact that Rule 66(A)(i) material has been disclosed to the Defence. Are there any other matters that the parties wish to raise today?

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: Your Honour, good afternoon again. I have just to confirm that in fact all the supporting material has gone out to date to the Defence, although we do appreciate the fact that, of course, we're dealing with Duty Counsel at this time. But all the supporting material has been provided, and some final B/C/S translations of that material previously disclosed were also provided to counsel today. So at this point, we don't anticipate any difficulties with the schedule that the Chamber has just reviewed with us. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct, Your Honour. I received some material accompanying the indictment today and one -- one month or three weeks ago.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thanks all of you. This hearing is now adjourned.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the Further Appearance adjourned at
